rules.as_of_default: Use publish_date and exclude information unavailable after window_end.
rules.missing_publish_date: Items missing publish_date go to missing_publish_date_review and do not enter as-of safe reports.
rules.future_publish_date: Items with publish_date later than window_end go to excluded_due_to_future_publish_date.
rules.non_publish_date_modes: Fiscal/reporting/event/data period modes can query records, but as_of_check still applies when enabled.
rules.as_of_disabled: When as_of_check_enabled=false, reports are marked not_asof_safe.
